label: caiso 59 lcr proxy
definition: PROBE (G-15 option C): LCR commitment credit proxy ON, ct_netload_drag OFF, local_capacity_constraints ON. Tests whether the P2 LCR-dual credit (CAISO BCR/CPM analogue, Tariff §40.6) replaces the drag as a commitment-value mechanism. CT 1.39/0.40/0.78 vs measured 3.05/3.30/1.65 TWh; avg price $68.05/$44.99/$51.04 vs actual ~$66/$45/$55. The proxy alone does NOT replace the drag's CT-holding effect — CT drops ~0.6–1.3 TWh/yr vs caiso-58 keeper — but it is structurally correct (real market mechanism). The remaining CT gap requires a complementary mechanism (D-8 closure §6: the drag carried both commitment-value AND scarcity-pricing roles).
